anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of De adoratione Book 16. Translated afresh from the PG 68 Greek on 2026-10-23; the withdrawn English was not used for wording.

apparatus.note: PG OCR; a column may cut mid-sentence or mid-word.

PG 68.1041. The section holds only the opening words of the quotation; the subject (Κύριος, ‘the Lord’) and the rest of the Nazirite law (Numbers 6:1–5 and following) fall in §18. ‘The Lord’ is moved into this section so the English reads naturally, and §18 begins ‘…to Moses, saying’.
